title: Core: AS2 Function class and function metadata
description: Test compilation of: fn.call(ctx, arg1, arg2), fn.apply(ctx, argsArray), fn.length (property), fn.toString(). Also test: function.caller (within a function body), arguments.callee, arguments.length. Each should compile. Verify ActionCallMethod (0x52) for .call/.apply, ActionGetMember (0x4f) for .length.
